AI now handles the tedious mathematical heavy lifting of pattern grading and sizing conversions across global standards, instantly generating precise technical drawings from your initial concepts. Your value lies in the final aesthetic touch and the technical problem-solving that ensures a design's integrity is maintained from a size XS to a 4XL.
